info.name: 2geda Social — WebSockets
info.description:
Every WebSocket endpoint in the 2geda Social API.

**Endpoints**
| Path | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `/ws/chat/` | Direct and group chat, presence, WebRTC calls |
| `/ws/notifications/` | Live notification stream |
| `/ws/polls/{poll_id}/` | Live poll voting and results |
| `/ws/posts/{post_id}/` | Live comments, likes and typing on one post |
| `/ws/feed/` | Live feed of new posts from people you follow |

**Authentication**

Every socket authenticates with a JWT access token in the query string: `?token=<access>`. There is no header auth — browsers cannot set headers on a WebSocket handshake. An invalid or missing token closes the connection immediately.

**Getting a token**

`POST {{http_base}}/api/v2/accounts/auth/login/` and copy `data.access` into the `jwt` collection variable.

**How to use this collection**

Each request is a WebSocket connection pre-filled with one message. Click **Connect**, then **Send**. The socket stays open, so you can switch between requests in a folder and keep sending on the same connection.

**Envelope**

Client frames are JSON with a `type` field. Requests that expect a reply take an optional `request_id`, echoed back on the matching `response` frame so you can correlate them.

item.name: Chat — /ws/chat/
item.description: Direct and group messaging, presence, search and WebRTC signalling. On connect you are auto-subscribed to every conversation you belong to.

item.name: Connection & conversations
item.description: Opening the socket and managing conversations.

request.description:
Open the socket. On success the server pushes the connection frame with your conversation ids and who is online.

**Server replies with:** `connected`

List every conversation you belong to.

**Server replies with:** `response`

Open (or reuse) a one-to-one conversation with another user.

**Server replies with:** `response`, `conversation_added`

Create a group conversation and add the initial members.

**Server replies with:** `response`, `conversation_added`
Subscribe this socket to a conversation you were added to after connecting.

Mark every message in the conversation as read.

**Server replies with:** `response`, `read_receipt`

item.name: Messaging
item.description: Sending, reading and deleting messages, plus typing indicators.

request.description:
Fetch a page of history. Pass `before` (an ISO timestamp or message id) to page backwards.

**Server replies with:** `response`

Send a text message. Set `reply_to_id` to quote an existing message.

**Server replies with:** `response`, `message`

body.raw:
{
  "type": "send_message",
  "request_id": "{{$guid}}",
  "conversation_id": "{{conversation_id}}",
  "body": "Hey, are you free for a call?",
  "reply_to_id": null
}

request.description:
Delete one of your own messages.

**Server replies with:** `response`, `message_deleted`

Tell the other members you are typing.

**Server replies with:** `typing_indicator`

Clear your typing indicator.

**Server replies with:** `typing_indicator`

Add one or more people to a group.

**Server replies with:** `response`, `group_members_updated`

Remove a member from a group. Admins only.

**Server replies with:** `response`, `member_removed`

Promote a member to group admin.

**Server replies with:** `response`, `member_promoted`

Lock or unlock the group so only admins can post.

**Server replies with:** `response`

Ask to join a group you are not a member of.

**Server replies with:** `response`, `join_request_created`

List pending join requests. Admins only.

**Server replies with:** `response`

Approve or reject a join request. `action` is `approve` or `reject`.

**Server replies with:** `response`, `group_members_updated`

Full-text search messages. Omit `conversation_id` to search everywhere you have access.

**Server replies with:** `response`

Search your conversations by name.

**Server replies with:** `response`

Search users you can start a conversation with.

**Server replies with:** `response`

Search shared media. `media_type` is image, video, audio or document.

**Server replies with:** `response`

Ask whether specific users are currently online.

**Server replies with:** `response`

item.name: Calls (WebRTC signalling)
item.description: The server only relays signalling frames between peers; media never touches it.

request.description:
Start a WebRTC call. `call_type` is `audio` or `video`; `sdp` is your local offer.

**Server replies with:** `call_offer`

Answer an incoming call with your SDP answer.

**Server replies with:** `call_answer`

Relay an ICE candidate to the peer. Sent repeatedly while negotiating.

**Server replies with:** `call_ice_candidate`

Tell the peer you turned your camera on or off.

**Server replies with:** `video_toggle`

Start or stop screen sharing mid-call.

**Server replies with:** `screen_share`

End the call for both sides.

**Server replies with:** `call_ended`

Keep-alive. Send every 20-30s while idle.

**Server replies with:** `pong`

Any unrecognised `type` returns a structured error rather than closing the socket.

**Server replies with:** `error`

item.name: Notifications — /ws/notifications/
item.description: Live notification stream for the authenticated user. New notifications are pushed as they happen; no polling required.

request.description:
Open the socket. The server sends the connection frame with your current unread count.

**Server replies with:** `connected`

Mark a single notification as read. The reply carries the updated unread count.

**Server replies with:** `marked_read`

Mark every notification as read.

**Server replies with:** `marked_all_read`

Keep-alive.

**Server replies with:** `pong`

item.name: Polls — /ws/polls/{poll_id}/
item.description: Live voting on one poll. Every connected client sees tallies update as votes land. Set the `poll_id` collection variable before connecting.

request.description:
Open the socket for one poll. The server sends the current options and tallies.

**Server replies with:** `connected`

Cast a vote. Rate-limited server-side; the updated tally is broadcast to everyone.

**Server replies with:** `vote.ack`, `poll_event`

Withdraw your vote from an option.

**Server replies with:** `unvote.ack`, `poll_event`

Keep-alive.

**Server replies with:** `pong`

item.name: Post — /ws/posts/{post_id}/
item.description: Live activity on a single post: new comments, likes, reshares and typing indicators. Set the `post_id` collection variable before connecting.

request.description:
Open the socket for one post and start receiving its activity.

**Server replies with:** `connected`

Show that you are writing a comment on this post.

**Server replies with:** `post_event`

Clear your typing indicator.

**Server replies with:** `post_event`

Keep-alive.

**Server replies with:** `pong`

item.name: Feed — /ws/feed/
item.description: Live feed for the authenticated user. New posts from people you follow are pushed as they are created. Receive-only apart from the keep-alive.

request.description:
Open the socket and start receiving feed events.

**Server replies with:** `connected`

Keep-alive.

**Server replies with:** `pong`

variable.description: WebSocket host and port, no scheme. The scheme is ws:// in the URL; change it to wss:// in production.
HTTP origin, used to obtain a JWT.
